items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Yeah I was working and we was rehearsing every day. But one day Jimmy Knepper came in, the cat hit him

ctx.x: Yeah I was working and we was rehearsing every day. But one day Jimmy Knepper came in, the cat hit him ‘cause he didn’t have some music written or something. It was terrible, a trombone player.
